text:
emily_marketing: Quick prelaunch SEO checklist for the webinar + benchmark post — can we triage keywords, structured data, internal-link anchors, and a small redirects sweep? Need owners before EOD.

sam_seo: @emily_marketing I'll own keyword clusters and SERP intent mapping. Quick question — should we lead with 'inference latency best practices' or 'inference cost optimization' for the benchmark narrative?

jia_content: My vote is latency first for the webinar promo (more native speaker interest), include cost as a deep-dive chapter in the benchmark piece. I'll draft H1/H2s and a short teaser.

sam_seo: Sounds good. I'll produce a primary/secondary keyword list (10 primary, 20 secondary) and map each to the landing + blog sections. I'll also note likely SERP features (featured snippet, PAA, code block).

evan_growth: I'll own redirects + canonicalization sweep. Can someone export the current URL inventory (landing, blog, product pages) to a shared sheet? I have a small grep + sitemap diff script to propose candidates.

seo-bot: Automated site scan completed for /webinar/* and /benchmarks/* — findings: 5 pages missing Event/Organization schema, 3 pages with duplicate rel=canonical, 2 weak internal anchors (generic 'learn more'). Full report: https://internal.redwood/seo/reports/1776502048

emily_marketing: Owners confirmed: @sam_seo keywords & anchor-text matrix, @jia_content content outlines + schema snippets, @evan_growth redirects & canonical fixes. Target first pass by tomorrow 3pm PT. Also need a one-sheet for devs with exact anchor text + hrefs so they can batch-update links.

sam_seo: I'll add an anchor-text CSV (columns: source_path, target_path, anchor_text, priority) and a short mapping doc that pairs keywords -> landing H2s. Will flag any pages that should get `rel=\"canonical\"` updates.

jia_content: I'll prepare the JSON-LD example for the webinar landing (Event + Organization) and put copy placeholders for date/time, speakers, registration CTA. Example to paste into CMS: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Production Inference Patterns","startDate":"2026-04-15T10:00:00-07:00","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

evan_growth: I exported the URL inventory to the shared sheet and tagged redirects candidates. Quick note: prefer 301 for permanent moved blog URLs, keep any A/B experiment paths as 302 until campaign ends. I'll run a CDN cache invalidation plan once we finalize.

emily_marketing: Great. Also: small internal linking strategy — link the product features doc to the benchmark post using anchors like 'inference latency' and 'GPU inference optimization', and from the benchmark post back to the webinar landing with CTAs. Avoid over-optimizing anchor repetition.

sam_seo: Noted. I'll include recommended anchor frequency per page and a light internal link priority score (1-3).

jia_content: Will iterate messaging once keyword map is in. I'll draft 3 webinar subject lines optimized for both open rates and keyword presence.

evan_growth: After redirects are queued, I'll coordinate with infra for any route changes and confirm we won't break tracking params (UTM preservation note).

emily_marketing: Thanks everyone — small deliverables: @sam_seo keyword CSV + anchor matrix, @jia_content content + JSON-LD snippets, @evan_growth redirects list + canonical fixes. Ping here when uploaded to /marketing/seo/launch-177650. :tada:
